## Checklist

- [ ] I added entries in **alphabetical order** in the right section
- [ ] Links go to the source repository (or the official site, for resources)
- [ ] Descriptions are one sentence, end with a period, and avoid hype words
- [ ] Projects have two tags, `License` then `Language`, and the license tag is accurate (`Custom` or `No license` if needed)
- [ ] It's **not** a cheat, Lua stealer, exploit tool or leaked/paid addon, and it isn't archived
- [ ] I'm affiliated with this project (tick if yes — that's fine, just let us know)
